newsitem.title: USA: Zenith cancels plans to build picture tube plant.
newsitem.headline: Zenith cancels plans to build picture tube plant.

text.p: Zenith Electronics Corp said Tuesday it cancelled plans to build an additional color picture tube plant in Illinois and cited current financing considerations and other capital investment priorities.

The project, which involved plans to build a plant in Woodridge, Ill., was deferred earlier this year while Zenith weighed its investment priorities and evaluated market conditions, said President Peter Wilmott, in a news release.

Based on current financing considerations, capital investment priorities are focused on a Melrose Park, Ill. plant, where Zenith has invested more than $100 million to install new automated production equipment for color picture tubes and a new production line for computer display tubes, the company said.
In addition, Zenith said tube prices have been declining making it more attractive to buy large-screen tubes from other manufacturers.
Last October, Zenith had announced plans to build at $100 million plant for the manufacture of 32-inch and 35-inch color picture tubes.

Despite the change in plans, Zenith said it remains committed to the large-screen home theater TV market. The company said it believes that its product and marketing plans for 1997-1998 will enhance its position in this industry category.
